column1: # Campylobacter jejuni NCTC 11168 proteins that change in abundance during growth in Mueller-Hinton medium with 0.1% deoxycholate compared with medium alone (TMT label-based quantitative proteomics)

# Man L, Dale AL, Klare WP, Cain JA, Sumer-Bayraktar Z, Niewold P, Solis N, Cordwell SJ. 2020. Proteomics of Campylobacter jejuni growth in deoxycholate reveals Cj0025c as a cystine transport protein required for wild-type human infection phenotypes. Mol Cell Proteomics 19(8):1263-1280. https://doi.org/10.1074/mcp.RA120.002029
# Source: Supplementary Data S1 (159411_1_supp_522812_q9nf8k.xlsx in mmc1.zip), sheet "Suppl. Data S1" (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC8015009/supplementaryFiles)

# Cutoff: the paper's own criteria for the 0.1% deoxycholate comparison, P < 0.05 and at least a log2 fold change of 0.6 (about 1.5-fold); 542 of the 1,315 quantified proteins in this table pass (the paper reports 512 after additionally requiring DIA-SWATH-MS validation for fold changes near the cutoff); top 75 in each direction by mean label n-fold
